department: Biological Sciences, School of Biological Sciences

deadline.value: The PhD rounds are 1 March, 1 July and 1 November, but the official page gives no year, so no 2027 deadline is recorded.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Students are encouraged to discuss projects with potential supervisors, though this is not necessary in order to apply.
supervisor.quote: Students are encouraged to discuss possible projects with potential supervisors or graduate coordinators although this is not necessary in order to apply.

funding.value: Wellington Doctoral Scholarships are awarded competitively and availability is limited; the application is part of the PhD application.
funding.quote: Scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis and availability is limited.

entry_route.value: A BSc(Hons) generally leads straight into PhD study; the page does not state a Master's route.
entry_route.quote: It generally allows students to progress directly to PhD study.

notes: The School's PhD is its highest degree and usually takes three to four years. No department fee, GRE or English rule.
